summary: Re-verified the chip-row vs first-card overlap fix on /pharmacy and /clinics (mobile viewport 390x844). The applied style change `chipScroll: { height: 56, marginBottom: spacing.md }` is PRESENT in both files, but the DOM-level overlap IS NOT fully resolved. Measured via DOM getBoundingClientRect on the actual chip TouchableOpacity (not the inner Text label): Pharmacy 'All' chip bottom = 179 vs Metformin 500 mg card top = 176 -> GAP = -3.00px (still overlapping). Clinics 'All' chip bottom = 86.66 vs UTH card top = 84.30 -> GAP = -2.36px (still overlapping). Previous iteration_8 reported ~4px overlap; the current overlap is smaller (~2-3px) so there is some improvement, but the spec requires strictly ABOVE, so the fix is NOT fully passing. Chip filtering works on both screens (Pharmacy 'Testing kits' -> Metformin hidden, glucometer/strips shown; Clinics 'Lusaka' -> 18 Lusaka clinics shown). Chips are vertically centered within the chip row and show full labels + icons.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip 'All' TouchableOpacity bbox (y=142, h=37, bottom=179) overlaps first card 'Metformin 500 mg' (y=176) by 3.00px at DOM level. Root cause: `style={{height:56}}` on <ScrollView style={styles.chipScroll}> does NOT propagate to the outer web div in react-native-web — the outer wrapper reports h=7 (collapsed to content container intrinsic height), so the 37px chips with alignItems:'center' overflow both above and below their nominal 56px track. Reference: /app/frontend/app/pharmacy.tsx:19,99-103

Chip 'All' TouchableOpacity bbox (y=49.66, h=37, bottom=86.66) overlaps first card 'University Teaching Hospital (UTH)' (y=84.30) by 2.36px at DOM level. Same root cause as pharmacy — outer wrapper collapses to h=7. Reference: /app/frontend/app/clinics.tsx:19,129-133

issues: Visually the chips (with rounded pill backgrounds) sit immediately adjacent to the first list card with a hairline overlap/touch at the bottom chip border. Not jarring to a casual user but still fails the strict 'chip bottom strictly above card top' spec.

react_native_issues.issue: In react-native-web, setting `style={{height:56}}` on a horizontal ScrollView does not force the outer wrapper div to be 56px tall; the ancestor collapses to the content container's intrinsic height (~7px) while chips overflow with alignItems:'center'. Recommended fix: wrap the ScrollView in <View style={{height:56, marginBottom: spacing.md, justifyContent:'center'}}> and remove height from chipScroll — OR use `maxHeight:56` + `minHeight:56` on contentContainerStyle — OR add explicit paddingVertical to chipScrollContent so the chip's bbox sits inside the track. Reference: /app/frontend/app/pharmacy.tsx:19 and /app/frontend/app/clinics.tsx:19

action_items: The height:56 on the ScrollView style is not taking effect in react-native-web — chip TouchableOpacity bbox still bleeds 2-3px into the first list card on BOTH screens. Please wrap the chip ScrollView in an outer <View style={{height:56, marginBottom: spacing.md, justifyContent:'center'}}> and move marginBottom there; leave chipScroll with no height. Alternatively add `paddingVertical: 10` (or ~10px) to chipScrollContent so the chip's 37px bbox is pushed inside a 56px+ track. Apply same change to both /app/frontend/app/pharmacy.tsx and /app/frontend/app/clinics.tsx.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: React Native Web renders a horizontal ScrollView as a nested set of divs. Setting `style={{height:56}}` on the ScrollView does not reliably force the outer wrapper div to 56px — in current rendering the wrapper collapses to the content container's intrinsic height (~7-8px), so the 37px-tall chip (paddingVertical:10 + 17 content) overflows above and below its own parent. With `marginBottom: spacing.md (16)` applied to that collapsed wrapper, the FlatList's first item starts only 16px below the wrapper's center, which is INSIDE the chip's overflow region, producing a 2-3px DOM overlap. Reproduction: open /pharmacy at 390x844, run getBoundingClientRect on `[data-testid=pharm-cat-all]` and `[data-testid=pharm-metformin-500]`, observe chip.bottom > card.top. Mitigation: wrap ScrollView in an outer View with explicit height:56 and justifyContent:'center' (reliable in RN-web), OR give chipScrollContent explicit paddingVertical so the chip bbox is pushed into the track, OR increase chipScroll marginBottom to spacing.lg so the overflow doesn't reach the card.
